Patient: I'm 61 years old, and I'm a male. I'm here for a routine follow-up because I have some chronic medical conditions, and I wanted to check in on how I'm doing overall.
Doctor: Could you please specify what chronic medical conditions you have?
Patient: I had an aortic valve replacement and an ascending aortic aneurysm repair back in 2013. Other than that, I don’t have any other chronic conditions that I’m aware of. I’ve been doing okay since then, but I wanted to make sure everything’s still on track.
Doctor: Could you please describe any symptoms you have been experiencing since your aortic valve replacement and ascending aortic aneurysm repair, such as chest pain, shortness of breath, dizziness, or fatigue?
Patient: I’ve been feeling more fatigued lately, especially after a long bike ride. I used to be able to ride 40 miles on a good day, but now I can only do 20 to 30 and I get really tired afterward. I also noticed that I purse my lips when I breathe, but I don’t have any wheezing or shortness of breath.
